subject: science
concept: Identifying the basic parts of a plant (root, stem, leaf, flower) and their general function
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student labels the parts of a real or virtual plant using part-name tiles
exercise.pictorial: Student matches each plant part to a simple description of its job
exercise.abstract: Student names a plant part when given a description of its function

misconception_flags: confuses stem and root function (which anchors/absorbs vs. which transports)

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
